result:
I updated `src/exports/links.ts` so `DownloadLink` now has `expiresAt: string`. `createDownloadLink` sets it to 7 days after creation, as an ISO timestamp. The URL now looks like `?token=…&expires=<URL-encoded ISO timestamp>`.

I haven't run or type-checked anything. I also didn't add any server-side check that rejects expired links. This change only puts the expiry on the link.
